name: Interactive block
description: Adds a server-rendered Gutenberg block driven by WordPress core's Interactivity API (core since WP 6.5). Generates block.json (supports.interactivity + viewScriptModule), a render.php emitting data-wp-* directives, a view.js store, the editor entry points, and a Registrable that registers the block from its build output and no-ops before WP 6.5.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the block class. Default 'Inc\Blocks' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the block class file. Default 'includes/Blocks'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Blocks'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Blocks'.

Source directory for block.json + render.php + view.js + the editor scripts (the inputs to @wordpress/scripts). Default 'src/blocks'. Keep the rendered file at '<blocks_dir>/<slug>/render.php': the rtCamp PHPCS ruleset exempts exactly 'src/blocks/*/render.php' from the file-header and text-domain sniffs a block render file cannot satisfy.

Compiled-output directory WordPress actually registers, where block.json, the bundled view.js and render.php land after a build. Default 'build/blocks' matches wp-scripts' default `--output-path`. Override to the project's real build path (the rtCamp skeleton uses 'assets/build/blocks').
Block slug, kebab-case, no vendor prefix, e.g. 'faq-accordion'.
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.
Human-readable block title shown in the editor.
Vendor prefix for the block name, e.g. 'rtcamp' produces 'rtcamp/faq-accordion'. Also the store namespace shared by render.php's data-wp-interactive and view.js's store().

wiring.description: Add the block class to the Blocks module so the framework Loader registers it on init. Interactive blocks share the Blocks module with dynamic ones; if it does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Blocks --kind=block-dynamic`.
